jobs.description:
As an Order Picker working in our dynamic 2-shift system, you'll be right in the heart of the action, responsible for:

• Scanning and sorting goods on pallets like a logistics whiz.
• Getting those orders prepped and ready to roll out.
• Ensuring every item is perfectly labeled and passes our top-notch quality checks.
• Becoming a master of the hand scanner - your essential sidekick!
• Tackling loading and unloading tasks with confidence.
• Conquering heights (up to 8 meters!) on our man-up equipment - it's your mission control to efficient order picking!
Excited to jump in and make a real impact? Got questions? Don't hesitate to ask!

Send an email to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15! 

VG599/BUOSAP

Are You the Awesome orderpicker we're looking for?

• You thrive in a fast-paced job with lots of variety in a clean and safe setting.
• You're not afraid of a bit of physical work - bring it on!
• You're looking for a full-time gig with long-term prospects.
• You're ready to dive in and start ASAP!
• Working in a 2-shift system (early/late) fits your lifestyle.
• You have previous experience working in a warehouse
• You have good communication skills in Engelish of Dutch 
• Heights? No sweat! You're ready to take on the warehouse from every angle.
- scanning and sorting goods on pallets

- preparing orders 

- labeling goods and checking for quality 

- working with a hand scanner

- loading and unloading goods

- working with a man-up at height (max. 8 meters)

This role requires strong technical knowledge, hands-on problem-solving skills, and a commitment to safety. You will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and respond promptly to repair requests.

Your main responsibilities as a Maintenance Technician:

• Maintain and repair automated systems as needed

• Perform maintenance and repairs on lift trucks

• Conduct electrical and mechanical maintenance on all equipment and installations

• Service and maintain order pickers, reach trucks, and combi trucks

The Maintenance Technician we are looking for possesses the following qualities:

• Engineering background

• Ability to work rotating shifts (6h-14h and 14h-22h)

• Hands-on and dynamic approach

• Precision and results-oriented mindset

• Takes initiative and assumes responsibility

• Team player who can also work independently

• Preferably experienced in welding

• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus

You work on a production line in the cold, warm or expedition department. You fill, garnish or label products and ensure everything runs smoothly with your colleagues. You follow strict hygiene and quality rules. You contribute to a safe and organized workplace.

• Good Dutch or fluent English

• Fast and accurate working style (line work)

• Strong focus on quality and hygiene

• Neat appearance (no gel nails, visible piercings, etc.)

• Comfortable working in cold (0–4°C)

• Team player

• Experience in production is a plus

Are you the type of person who is always ready to help others? Do you have a passion for customer service and want to be part of a dynamic team? We are looking for an enthusiastic Customer Service Representative who can elevate customer satisfaction with a smile. In this role, you’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, ensuring they receive the right support. You have excellent communication skills and can multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment

Your tasks and responsibilities as a Customer Service Representative:

• Responsible for assigned customer accounts and backup for the entire order life cycle (from new customer set-up, order entry/modification, escalations; responsibilities might include logistics management) to ensure orders are shipped to agreed deadline.

• Act as the single-point-of-contact to customers, parts distribution centers and/or manufacturing plants and cross functional departments to process and fulfil customer orders; providing accurate documentation and continual communication to customer throughout the process.

• Take ownership of and resolve complex customer inquiries through extensive research, a detailed understanding of processes, systems, and practices; provide timely and informative responses as per the Service Level Agreement.

• Request support from the next appropriate level of customer support for complex escalations/issues providing documentation throughout the process.

• Maintain accurate records of all internal and external interactions in the appropriate database/system.

• Ensure customers comply with export polices and ensure required export/shipping documentation is compiled to the relevant legislation.

• Prepare and distribute standard and customized internal and customer reports.

• Understand Customer Order Management policies, procedures and metrics.

• Support Customer Order Management departmental goals and initiatives to become a more proactive customer support organization.

• Participate in/lead process improvement projects.

The Customer Service Representative we're looking for has the following characteristics:

• You have a very good knowledge of English (written and verbal)

• You communicate effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

• You are strong at building customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

• You're actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels. 

• You demonstrate the phases of the end-to-end order life cycle, terminology and functional collaboration that enable customer orders to be fulfilled; describes how the order life cycle and customer support are interconnected to ensure an overall positive customer experience.

• Customer Support - Demonstrates how proactive customer support interactions are required at each phase of the order life cycle to ensure customer satisfaction; describes how customer support and the order life cycle are interconnected to ensure an overall positive customer experience.

• You demonstrate the steps necessary to manage the processing of customer orders through order receipt, exception identification and resolution to ensure orders are fulfilled to customer requirements.

Are you an experienced orderpicker who speaks fluent English or Dutch and wants to work in a 2 shift system in Westerlo? VG599/BUOSAP

• You possess a stable first experience as an orderpicker in a warehouse environment.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions

• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.

• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.
• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

Team/division description:
 

Lexus, One Omnichannel Experience (Lexus, OCX) is the Function that is the promoting the LEXUS brand 360 degree and delivers one seamless omnichannel experience across physical and digital touchpoints. The Function brings under one roof Divisions such as Lexus Brand, Digital Experience & E-Commerce, Data Platforms & Customer Engagement Management (CEM), Customer Relations, Strategy & Performance, and One Academy. Its mission is to define and connect every customer touchpoint across the ONE TOYOTA Ecosystem in an omnichannel way to drive conversion, loyalty and monetisation. AI based automation and self-services are unlocking cost efficiencies, while a system of actionable insights is leading to continuous performance improvements. A unified, centrally governed and legally compliant data foundation is the key enabler for building long term trusted relationships with our customers.
 

Due to its multiple impact across the business, the function should collaborate seamlessly with other TME functions and NMSCs as the primary implementer.
 

Your task: 
 

 
• Agenda, Mailbox, Expense & Travel Management: Manage the Function Head’s agenda, mailbox, travel booking, and expenses.
 
• Team Travel & Expenses: Support team Heads with travel and expenses upon request.
 
• Travel Coordination: Share travel-related information across the function.
 
• All Team meeting organization: Organize Quarterly All Team meeting – book venue, collect and consolidate presentations from each team, present team related content.
 
• Weekly Direct reports meeting / Bi-Weekly Lexus Team Meeting: set-up meeting (including meeting room), consolidate PowerPoint presentation for the meetings, create midterm agenda visibility.
 
• Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.
 
• Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.
 
• Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.
 
• Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.
 
• (Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)
 
• Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.
 
• Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.
 
• One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions. 

Your profile:
 

 
• Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.
 
• Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.
 
• Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.
 
• Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.
 
• Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.
 
• Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.
 
• Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.
 
• Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.
 
• Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.
 
• Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

VetPharm Global is an international partner in animal health, specialising in the distribution of veterinary medicines, vaccines and feed additives. From our head office in Belgium and through a commercial network and operations in Europe, Asia and South America, we support vets, producers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative and scientifically backed solutions. with a strong focus on quality, expertise and customer focus, we contribute to sustainable and effective animal health.
 

To support the further growth of our operations in Brazil, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager. 
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

Team/division description:
 

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation within P&I). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.
 

At P&I we strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.
 

 
• HR Data Governance & Data Quality
 
• Business Analysis within HR Data Domain
 
• Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team
 
• Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)
 
• Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)
 
• Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)
 
• Monitoring testing and release management
 
• Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed 

Your profile:
 

 
• English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.
 
• Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role
 
• Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset
 
• Stakeholder Management
 
• Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors
 
• Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.
 
• Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams
 
• The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.
 
• Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

?? No fear of heights
